Method of Attack: remote code execution via specially crafted POST request to AuUploader component
Impacted Systems: systems using ZK Framework versions 9.6.1, 9.6.0.1, 9.5.1.3, 9.0.1.2 and 8.6.4.1
Attack Vector: ZK Framework AuUploader servlet file content retrieval vulnerability
Indicators of Compromise: malicious database driver with backdoor functionality deployed on R1Soft Server Backup Manager
